description: This file defines configuration-related classes for persistent streams in the Orleans framework, including a validator for stream storage configuration and a configurator class for silo persistent streams.

classes.name: PersistentStreamStorageConfigurationValidator
classes.description: Validates the configuration of stream pub-sub options and associated storage services for persistent streams in Orleans.

classes.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures persistent stream providers within an Orleans silo, setting up services, components, and validators.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the required grain storage is configured based on pubsub type; throws exception if misconfigured.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method for creating an instance of PersistentStreamStorageConfigurationValidator.

methods.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the configurator with necessary components and delegates for setting up persistent streaming.
